d: Ash blonde hair, very long and flowing with a single small cowlick on top and bangs framing the face. Sharp, sapphire blue eyes with a confident expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender, athletic build. Wearing a white military-style jacket with gold accents and a navy blue sash, paired with a white and navy blue flowing cape, white thigh-high stockings with gold and black criss-cross straps, and black heeled ankle boots. Holding a long, high-tech spear with a glowing cyan tip and flowing blue ribbons.
